label: Finding-102
title: scale-70pc-internet: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: The BBC's quoted Wiz words 'roughly 70%' are not in either Wiz capture: The BBC puts "roughly 70%" in quotation marks as Wiz's estimate. Wiz's blog says 'affecting 70% of the Internet' (headline) and 'powers 70% of all websites in the world' (body); the X post says 'impacting 70% of the Internet'. The word 'roughly' is the BBC's. The claim text adopts 'Roughly' and attributes it to Wiz; it should either drop 'Roughly' or attribute the hedge to the BBC.
